**Froze A7 revert-of-a-revert finder fixture (RED vs mutant) for brain-audit**

**What**: Authored + froze an adversarial E2E finder fixture in brain/scripts/brain-audit.test.mjs pinning the property "a live-at-HEAD ungoverned artifact must always be reported, regardless of revert/re-revert depth". Test name: "brain-audit: A7 revert-of-a-revert ...". Proven RED against the frozen mutant; left uncommitted/unstaged.

**Why**: Governance issue #297 finder≠patch-author split. Finder proves RED against a frozen historical mutant without learning the fix's absence-computation mechanism.

**Where**: brain/scripts/brain-audit.test.mjs (appended before the prView fix-at-source test); added existsSync import; new module-level helpers headShaOf/mergeAddingPayload/genuineRevertMerge (E2E adaptation of resolution.test.mjs helpers into brain-audit.test.mjs's makeRepo/commit house style).

**Learned**: Attack = O (merge adding 500-line file, fails diffSize>400) → R (git revert -m1 O as first-parent merge, removes payload) → R2 (git revert -m1 R as merge, re-adds exact payload LIVE at HEAD). Each merge carries Closes #N and a session_summary record sits at HEAD so diffSize is the only axis. Assertions are FORMAT-AGNOSTIC (work for current-branch [FAIL] AND correct-fix [FAIL-SHA]): exit non-zero; R2 line not startsWith [SKIP]; O line not startsWith [SKIP]; skipCount<auditedCount anti-whitewash. The ONLY valid RED baseline is git ref archive/d2-pr3-superseded-9233880 (direction-blind reverter-skip) — at HEAD=R2 it emits all-[SKIP]/exit 0 (R2 "revert of a0ca187", R "resolved by revert", O "revert of a0ca187"). Current greenfield branch feat/issue-259-d2-pr3-net-parity-reverter-skip passes VACUOUSLY (no reverter-skip machinery), NOT a valid RED baseline. The A1..A5/mergeAddingPayload helpers the task referenced live in resolution.test.mjs (unit test of predicate), not in brain-audit.test.mjs.
